Razmatranje parkinga bih precizirao pitanjem da li je prikazana promena na Obilićevom vencu prostorno izolovana, umesto da joj pripisujem večernji ritam. [F3][F4][F5]

I would refine the parking discussion by asking whether the displayed change at Obilićev venac is spatially isolated, rather than assigning it an evening rhythm [F5].
